summary:
Adversarial verification of the storage-infra review against main @ 31d512f. Read-only; no cargo run. Every cited file was opened. Result: 9 confirmed, 15 adjusted, 0 findings fully refuted, plus one sub-recommendation refuted inside storage-infra-07 and the error.rs split.

The review's substance holds. Its line numbers for bookmarks.rs (118 lines), report_history.rs (261), secret.rs (74), xdg.rs (58) and config/connections.rs (179) are wrong: many point past the end of the file. They are corrected below.

Main corrections:
(1) SceneRegistry has 12 fields, not 13; AppConfig has 15, not 16.
(2) Moving AppError::user_message into ui/ is refuted. controller/workspace.rs, controller/output_controller.rs and obs/audio_presets.rs call it, and fl! is used across domain/, services/ and controller/, so i18n in infra is the project convention, not a layering bug.
(3) LiveConfig.show_roles, allow_switching_only and audio_inputs are never read in production. Only scene_previews is used. Do not wrap them in a RoleKey type; delete or wire them. docs/configuration.md:86-91 claims audio_inputs filters audio, which is false.
(4) storage-infra-05 is stronger than reported. controller/dependencies.rs:58-61 calls read_config() on every connect, so a migration write-back, or a preserve_unparsable_config rename to .invalid, can run off the Config FIFO lane mid-session.
(5) storage-infra-20 is concrete: AppState derives Debug (src/controller/state.rs:437-438) and holds obs_password: Option<String> (state.rs:456).
(6) Severity of storage-infra-01 is lowered from critical to high. It is a design debt, not data loss.

Implementation order stays as the reviewer gave it: fixtures (14) first, then mechanical splits, then value objects, the domain aggregate, errors, schema versioning and locking.

findings.title: Storage DTO SceneRegistry is the live domain aggregate (no anti-corruption layer)
findings.smell: Large Class / Inappropriate Intimacy / Feature Envy
findings.evidence: SceneRegistry derives Serialize/Deserialize (registry.rs:22) and is embedded in show_workspaces.rs:96-100 StoredWorkspace. It holds rename_scene (171-212), ordering (215-249), set_scene_role/icon/tags/favorite/accent (277-476), SceneEntry::is_empty (385-392), reconcile_scenes (identity.rs:22), and SceneFilter::matches/save_deck/can_save_deck (decks.rs:36-76). AppState and its cache hold it: controller/state/show_registry.rs:6,24,91,106,124. UI imports: ui/persist.rs (13 mentions), ui/window.rs (9), ui/pages/live.rs (7), ui/pages/inventory.rs (4), ui/pages/graph.rs (4). snapshot() (252-270) is the only domain conversion.
findings.recommendation: 1) Before creating src/domain/curation/, note that src/domain/registry.rs already holds SceneRegistrySnapshot, SceneMetadata and GraphDependencyPolicy. Either grow it into src/domain/registry/ or create src/domain/curation/ and move the snapshot types there. Do not keep two 'registry' vocabularies. 2) Move the behaviour (rename, ordering, setters, reconcile_scenes, SceneFilter, deck rules) into an aggregate named ShowCuration. 3) Keep serde derives on domain value objects that already carry them (ActionBinding, OperatorPin, AudioRule and AudioPreset already live in domain with serde). The storage root DTO then only maps field-for-field. Duplicating every type as a storage DTO costs a lot and buys little. 4) Point AppState, show_registry.rs and ui/persist.rs at ShowCuration. 5) Add an architecture_tests.rs rule forbidding ui/ from naming crate::storage::registry. Domain may not import storage (architecture_tests.rs:625), so the mapper must live in storage, as the reviewer says. Do this after 14, 02 and 04.
findings.risk: Curation rules are coupled to the wire format, and changes spread across GTK pages.
findings.verifier_note: Code facts confirmed. Severity lowered from critical to high: this is design debt with no data loss, security hole or crash path. The '19 direct .scenes.get/insert/remove sites' count is 11 in ui/ and controller/ by grep (the larger figure likely includes tests). Added the clash with the existing domain/registry.rs and the pragmatic serde-on-domain note. depends_on now includes 14.

findings.title: SceneRegistry has 12 fields spanning 5 bounded contexts
findings.smell: Large Class / Divergent Change / Data Clumps
findings.evidence: Fields: scenes, scene_uuids, retained_scenes, scene_order, scene_filter, decks, action_bindings, quick_actions, audio_alerts, audio_presets, inputs and rules. That is 12, not 13. The YAML import sanitiser at 655-678 touches scene_uuids, retained_scenes, action_bindings, quick_actions and audio_alerts. The fully qualified types (std::collections::BTreeMap, crate::domain::...) at 39-61 are confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Split into flattened sections as proposed, keeping declaration order identical so serialised key order is unchanged: scenes, scene_uuids, retained_scenes, scene_order | scene_filter, decks | action_bindings, quick_actions | audio_alerts, audio_presets, inputs | rules. The proposed sections are already contiguous in the current order. Caveats to prove with the golden fixture (storage-infra-14): (a) each section struct needs Default and its own per-field #[serde(default)]; (b) #[serde(flatten)] buffers through serde's private Content type, so check serde_saphyr round-trips and that deserialize_with on decks and audio_presets still applies inside a flattened section; (c) flatten forbids deny_unknown_fields, which is not used here today. Give each section its own sanitize_for_import.
findings.risk: A new per-workspace feature can miss the import sanitiser and re-enable imported hotkeys.
findings.verifier_note: Field count corrected from 13 to 12. Lines and sanitiser claims verified. Added the key-order and flatten caveats.

findings.title: Unknown fields from newer builds are silently erased on next save; registry.json has no schema version
findings.evidence: Confirmed. AppConfig and SceneRegistry have no catch-all field and no deny_unknown_fields. migrate() only warns when version > CURRENT_VERSION (328-334). write_config_to_path (380-405) clones the config and writes it, skipping only normalize_connections (394), so unknown keys are dropped while the newer version number is written back. The newer build then reads a 'v999' file missing its own fields. The test future_config_is_not_rewritten_to_materialize_connection_profiles (config.rs:453) covers only the read path. SceneRegistry has no version field. bookmarks.rs:10-12 and report_history.rs:19-21 use deny_unknown_fields with version checks.
findings.recommendation: As proposed. Notes: serde_json::Value implements Eq, so SceneRegistry's Eq derive survives an extra: Map. Put the flatten catch-all last. Strip extra in write_registry_yaml_to_path, or document that it travels. For AppConfig, the catch-all must not capture legacy keys that are named fields: theme_mode is consumed by legacy_theme_mode at line 61, so it will not leak. Prefer 'refuse write when on-disk version > CURRENT' (simple and testable) over silent preservation, and pair it with storage-infra-10.
findings.risk: Data loss across version skew.
findings.verifier_note: Verified against config.rs:317-405 and registry.rs:22-72. Added the observation that the newer version number is written back while its fields are dropped.

findings.title: Primitive obsession: accent colour and icon key stored and passed as String; LiveConfig role lists are dead config
findings.evidence: accent_color: Option<String> (registry.rs:99). scene_accent_hex and parse_scene_accent (504-528) are called from ui/widgets/scene_card.rs:16,339 and ui/pages/inventory.rs:17,1187,1202. icon: Option<String> (103, 111). RuleConfig holds string role keys (115-126) parsed by parse_role_list (571-581) through SceneRole::from_rule_key (domain/role.rs:44). New evidence: grep across src finds no production reads of LiveConfig.show_roles, allow_switching_only or audio_inputs. Only live.scene_previews is used (ui/previews.rs, ui/pages/settings.rs:63-68, ui/pages/live.rs:670). docs/configuration.md:88-89 says live.audio_inputs is an allow-list that filters scene audio, which does not happen.
findings.recommendation: 1) Add an AccentColor value object as proposed (in src/domain/curation/accent.rs, or wherever storage-infra-01 settles), with string serde and a lenient parse that keeps invalid hand edits as None, and update the 2 UI files. 2) Add IconKey as a newtype in src/domain/icon.rs, next to icon_choice/icon_name. 3) Do not add a separate RoleKey enum. SceneRole plus from_rule_key already covers it. Use a lenient deserialize to Vec<SceneRole> in RuleConfig, logging and dropping unknown keys as parse_role_list does today. 4) LiveConfig.show_roles, allow_switching_only and audio_inputs are dead. Either remove them, keeping them readable through #[serde(default, skip_serializing)] or the storage-infra-03 catch-all, or wire them up. Then fix docs/configuration.md:86-91, which currently states false behaviour for audio_inputs. Add serde round-trip tests first.
findings.risk: Accent validation lives in storage and is called by GTK. The dead config misleads users and the docs.
findings.verifier_note: Accent and icon claims confirmed. The RoleKey-for-LiveConfig part is replaced: those fields are never read. Typing dead fields is waste, and the docs drift is a real defect. Severity lowered to medium because there is no correctness bug in accent or icon handling.

findings.title: Config read has side effects (migration write-back, swallowed error; rename on parse failure) and is called from the controller off-lane
findings.smell: Side effect in query / swallowed error
findings.evidence: config.rs:240-242 discards the write result with `let _ = write_config_to_path(...)`. New evidence: read_config() is called by FileAppConfigProvider::load_config (controller/dependencies.rs:58-61) on each connect, not only at startup (app.rs:43). So the migration write and preserve_unparsable_config (config.rs:252, rename to .invalid) can run from the Tokio side, outside SerialLane::Config (ui/background_io.rs:51-58). The comment at config.rs:391-392 shows the authors wanted to avoid exactly that. A hand edit with a typo while the app runs gets renamed away on the next connect.
findings.recommendation: 1) Make read_config_from_path pure: return LoadedConfig { config, startup_notice, pending_write: Option<AppConfig> } and never write or rename inside it. 2) app.rs startup performs the pending write and the .invalid preservation once, and logs failures with tracing::warn!. 3) FileAppConfigProvider uses a side-effect-free read and on parse failure returns an error or the cached AppState config, never renaming. 4) Tests: a read-only dir with a v2 config produces no panic, a warning and an unchanged file; calling load_config with an invalid file leaves config.json in place.
findings.risk: Silent persistence failure, repeated migrations, and an off-lane write or rename racing GTK-lane config writes.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed and strengthened with the controller call path. Dropped the reviewer's claim that step 3 is 'idempotent only by luck': on failure the disk still holds v3, so a re-run recomputes from the on-disk obs. That sub-claim was speculative.

findings.title: No inter-process lock on config/registry/workspace stores; snap build is NON_UNIQUE
findings.evidence: RegistryTarget::write reads the store at 54 and writes it at 63 with no lock. load_or_create (71-93) does the same. app.rs:79-83 sets NON_UNIQUE when SNAP is set. report_history.rs:136-149 is the only lock: path.with_extension("lock"), O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, is_file check and try_lock, then compare-expected at 150-153. The reviewer cited 372-388, which is past the end of the 261-line file.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: extract src/storage/lock.rs from report_history.rs:130-149 and lock a separate .lock file, never the data file, because atomic::write renames over the data inode. Wrap config, registry, workspace and bookmarks writes in it, and return a distinct Busy error that the UI shows as a toast. A per-file lock (<file>.lock) keeps the Config and Registry lanes independent. One dir-wide lock would make them contend.
findings.risk: Last-writer-wins loss across two processes. Only reachable with the snap build or a forced second instance.
findings.verifier_note: Substance confirmed. Corrected the report_history line refs. Severity lowered to medium: outside snap, GApplication uniqueness forwards a second launch to the first instance.

findings.title: AppError is stringly-typed, loses source chains, and has a test-only variant
findings.evidence: Confirmed: String variants (13, 17, 26), Display-erasing constructors (31-49), and cfg(test) Config, config() and notification_title() (20-22, 41-44, 75-82). Refuted part: AppError::user_message is not UI-only. Callers include controller/workspace.rs:170,210,312,352,418, controller/output_controller.rs:148,151,482, obs/audio_presets.rs:20,44,61, ui/window.rs (6 sites) and ui/pages/settings.rs:799. fl! also appears in domain/ (icon.rs, diagnostic.rs, audio.rs), services/doctor_format.rs and several controller files.
findings.recommendation: 1) Add structured variants with sources kept (Arc<dyn Error + Send + Sync> or Arc<io::Error>, because AppError must stay Clone for AppEvent). Migrate gradually: add AppError::Storage(StorageError) beside the String variant first. 2) Delete the cfg(test) Config variant and config(), and remove the 'error-config' key from every i18n/<locale>/scenedeck.ftl; the parity test requires all locales to change together. Keep the 'error-notification-title' key, which ui/window.rs:1437 uses. notification_title() itself can go once its tests are rewritten. 3) Do not move user_message to src/ui/error_text.rs. That would make controller/ and obs/ depend on ui/. Keep it in infra, or move it to src/infra/error_text.rs if separation is wanted.
findings.risk: UX cannot branch on error kind, for example to offer 'unlock keyring'.
findings.verifier_note: The structured-error and dead-variant parts are confirmed. Moving user_message into ui/ is refuted because controller/ and obs/ call it. Added the i18n key cleanup.

findings.title: Three incompatible storage error styles; typed RegistryStorageError flattened into io::Error::other
findings.evidence: RegistryStorageError (registry.rs:129-149) is flattened by io::Error::other at show_workspaces.rs:38,81 and registry.rs:643. Ad-hoc InvalidData strings: show_workspaces.rs:144-147, bookmarks.rs:45-48, report_history.rs:34-36. report_history.rs:151-153 reports a concurrency conflict as io::Error::other. secret.rs:16-19 wraps input validation as AppError::storage. The reviewer's line numbers for bookmarks, report_history and secret were past end of file and are corrected here.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: a src/storage/error.rs StorageError taxonomy, converting one store at a time. Keep io::ErrorKind::NotFound semantics, which the callers in RegistryTarget::read and show_registry rely on (for example 'show workspace is missing'), as an explicit StorageError::Missing variant.
findings.risk: The UI cannot give accurate guidance, and error matching depends on strings.
findings.verifier_note: Substance confirmed; line refs corrected. Added the NotFound-preservation note.

findings.title: AppConfig is a 15-field public bag with a denormalised `obs` endpoint kept in sync by hand
findings.smell: Large Class / Data Clumps / Temporal Coupling
findings.evidence: 15 fields (config.rs:26-63), counting legacy_theme_mode. obs is re-synced in normalize_connections (connections.rs:47-56), save_connection (70-72), select_connection (98) and before every write (config.rs:393-396). The endpoint string is formatted at config.rs:358 and connections.rs:43. The magic string "default" appears at config.rs:161, connections.rs:40, secret.rs:21, controller/session_controller.rs:338 and controller/state.rs:1750. The reviewer's connections.rs line numbers (158-263) were past the 179-line file and are corrected here.
findings.recommendation: As proposed, with these notes. (a) Flattening AppConfig sections must keep deserialize_with = connections::deserialize_connections (config.rs:37) and the legacy_theme_mode rename plus skip_serializing (61) working; prove it with the golden fixture. (b) Add ConnectionId with a DEFAULT constant in a new src/domain/connection.rs. (c) IPv6 host:port ambiguity is low risk: the endpoint string is used only as an identity key (WorkspaceKey, legacy_registry_endpoint, SessionReport.endpoint), so a collision needs two hosts that differ only in colon placement. Fix it as part of Endpoint, but not as a priority. Changing the Display format would change existing WorkspaceKey values on disk, so keep the legacy string for keys and use a migration if the format ever changes.
findings.risk: Connection changes need edits in several places, and the obs mirror can drift.
findings.verifier_note: Field count corrected from 16 to 15 and connections.rs lines corrected. Added the warning that the Endpoint format is an on-disk key.

findings.title: An older build moves a newer-but-valid config aside and starts on defaults
findings.evidence: Confirmed: any serde error leads to preserve_unparsable_config, which renames to config.json.invalid (288-289) and overwrites a previous backup (283-286, documented as deliberate). The next launch with the file missing reports FirstLaunch (256-258). The same rename can also be triggered from the controller connect path (controller/dependencies.rs:60), as noted under storage-infra-05.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: VersionProbe { version: Option<u32> } before renaming; if version > CURRENT_VERSION, run without the rename and refuse writes. Test: version 999 plus an unknown connection field stays at config.json.
findings.risk: Settings look lost across version skew, and onboarding is shown again.
findings.verifier_note: Verified. deserialize_connections starts at connections.rs:105 (reviewer cited 255-263, past end of file).

findings.title: O_NOFOLLOW on config files refuses symlinked dotfiles and makes every later save fail
findings.evidence: Facts confirmed: O_NOFOLLOW at small_file.rs:21; ReadFailed at config.rs:260-263; write_config_to_path re-reads at 383-390 and returns the error. This is a deliberate, documented policy: small_file.rs:14 says 'Symlinks and special files are deliberately unsupported at this boundary.' Also, atomic::write renames a temp file over the path (atomic.rs:51), so even if reads followed links, a save would replace the symlink with a regular file.
findings.recommendation: Minimum (S): detect ELOOP (raw_os_error == libc::ELOOP) and show a specific startup notice ('config.json is a symlink; SceneDeck does not follow symlinks') instead of the generic read-failed one, and document this in docs/configuration.md. Optional, as a product decision: a read_owned path that canonicalises once, checks uid, and writes atomically into the resolved target's directory. That needs its own security review because it widens the trust boundary.
findings.risk: Dotfile managers lose settings changes, with only a generic notice.
findings.verifier_note: Facts confirmed, but this is intentional, documented policy. Severity lowered to low, the minimum fix scoped to a clear notice plus docs, and support for symlinks reframed as a product decision.

findings.title: Storage localises ConfigStartupNotice (fl! in storage)
findings.evidence: Confirmed: storage/config.rs imports fl and LANGUAGE_LOADER only for user_message (206-228). Its only caller is app.rs:439. No other storage file uses fl!. However, fl! is used in domain/, services/ and controller/, so presentation strings outside ui/ are the project convention.
findings.recommendation: Low-cost cleanup: move rendering to app.rs or src/ui/startup_notice.rs (its only caller is app.rs:439). Optionally add an architecture_tests.rs rule that src/storage/ must not name LANGUAGE_LOADER; the existing violations() helper (architecture_tests.rs:351) supports it.
findings.risk: Minor coupling: storage tests touch the Fluent loader.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed, but it is a project-wide convention rather than a layering violation. Severity lowered to low.

findings.title: Test-only production API (#[cfg(test)] RegistryMutationError, mutate_registry, free set_scene_icon, *_from_path)
findings.evidence: Confirmed: these are all cfg(test). Users: every_registry_json_write_refuses_a_corrupt_original (820, with mutate_registry at 844), set_scene_role_from_path_* (1351, 1379) and remove_scene_entry_* (1395, 1433).
findings.recommendation: As proposed: port these tests to RegistryTarget::File(path).read()/write() and delete the items.
findings.risk: The tests exercise a path production never takes.
findings.verifier_note: Verified line by line.

findings.title: No golden wire-format fixtures guard the on-disk schemas before restructuring
findings.evidence: Confirmed: src/storage/fixtures/ does not exist, and the tests round-trip structs only.
findings.recommendation: As proposed. Load fixtures with include_str!. Compare JSON as serde_json::Value. For YAML, compare text: HashMap fields (scenes, scene_uuids, inputs) serialise in nondeterministic order, so either keep at most one entry per HashMap in the YAML fixture or compare the parsed value. This is the gate before storage-infra-01, 02 and 09.
findings.risk: A refactor could silently break existing users' files.
findings.verifier_note: Added the HashMap-ordering caveat for byte comparison.

findings.title: Migration chain is a hand-rolled while/match with a no-op step and an unreachable arm
findings.evidence: Confirmed: step 4 (362-365) only bumps the version; the `_` arm (366-369) is unreachable under while version < CURRENT_VERSION (336), because every value 0 through 4 is matched. The doc comment at 305-316 records the earlier short-circuit bug. show_workspaces.rs:136 accepts only version 1 and has no migration.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: a migrations.rs step table plus a separate normalize(). Severity lowered to low; it is a maintainability issue only.
findings.risk: Future ordering or short-circuit bugs.
findings.verifier_note: Verified. Severity lowered from medium to low.

findings.title: Whole multi-workspace store re-read and rewritten on every single-workspace edit, capped at one registry's limit
findings.evidence: Confirmed: read_store (121-132) and write_store (152-157) both use REGISTRY_LIMIT = 8 MiB (small_file.rs:10). load_or_create adopts a legacy registry of up to 8 MiB into the same store (79-91).
findings.recommendation: As proposed. Do the short-term WORKSPACE_STORE_LIMIT plus a boundary test first. Defer the per-file layout until the locking work (storage-infra-06) lands.
findings.risk: Write amplification, and a hard failure once the store grows.
findings.verifier_note: Verified.

findings.title: Domain invariants of SessionReport and Bookmark are enforced in storage
findings.evidence: Confirmed at the corrected lines: HistoryArchive::validate (42-84), upsert identity collision (86-101), retain (104-108) and BookmarkArchive::validate (30-51). The reviewer cited 275-358, past end of file. The limits are already domain constants: domain/session_report (EVENT_LIMIT, SAMPLE_LIMIT, HISTORY_LIMIT) and domain/bookmark (BOOKMARK_LIMIT, valid_name).
findings.recommendation: As proposed: SessionReport::validate goes to src/domain/session_report.rs (this is a file today; converting it to a directory to add history.rs is fine), and BookmarkLedger rules go to src/domain/bookmark.rs. Storage keeps the version check and the call at its boundary. upsert currently returns io::Error; the domain version should return a domain error that storage maps.
findings.risk: Invariants are checked only at save time.
findings.verifier_note: Line refs corrected; substance confirmed.

findings.title: CSV exporter builds rows by magic positional index (values[13], vec![String::new(); 14])
findings.smell: Primitive Obsession / Magic Numbers / Long Method
findings.evidence: Confirmed: vec![String::new(); 14] at 96, 102 and 168; index writes at 97-99, 103-138 and 169-173.
findings.recommendation: As proposed. The guarding tests are csv_quotes_multiline_cells_and_neutralizes_formula_prefixes (189) and exports_keep_acknowledgement_separate_from_file_evidence_and_roundtrip (198). Keep formula neutralisation in cell() (35).
findings.risk: Misaligned columns.
findings.verifier_note: Verified.

findings.title: Relative XDG_* values accepted and a CWD fallback; base-dir logic duplicated
findings.evidence: Confirmed at the corrected lines: report_history_path (28-42) and config_dir (45-58) duplicate the env chain, accept relative paths and fall back to '.'. Inline filenames at 21, 25 and 41. The reviewer cited 22-70, past the 58-line file.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: base_dir(var, home_suffix) accepting only absolute paths. Returning Option means changing about six callers of config_path() and registry_path(), so a simpler step is to keep the PathBuf return and log a warning on the fallback.
findings.risk: Config written to an unexpected directory.
findings.verifier_note: Line refs corrected; substance confirmed.

findings.title: Keyring secrets passed as plain String and cached in a Debug-derived AppState
findings.evidence: secret_user (14-26) special-cases "default" and returns AppError::storage for an empty id (16-19). get_obs_password returns Option<String> (33-39). New concrete evidence: AppState derives Debug and Clone (controller/state.rs:437-438) and holds pub obs_password: Option<String> (456). Any {:?} of AppState would print the password. I did not check whether such a log call exists.
findings.recommendation: 1) Now: give AppState a manual Debug impl that redacts the password, or wrap the password in SecretString with a redacting Debug and no Display. 2) Zeroising is best effort: obws needs a String at connect. Only add the zeroize dependency after a cargo deny check. 3) Take &ConnectionId once storage-infra-09 lands.
findings.risk: The plaintext password can leak through debug logging.
findings.verifier_note: Lines corrected (the reviewer cited 84-124 in a 74-line file). Severity raised to medium because of the Debug-derived AppState holding the password.

findings.title: Invalid registry.json at startup silently becomes empty curation (warn log only)
findings.evidence: Confirmed: read_registry falls back to the default with a warn (590). It is used at app.rs:51. Other production uses are only tests (ui/window.rs:1937+, ui/pages/inventory.rs:1611, 1674).
findings.recommendation: As proposed. First check whether StartupData.registry (app.rs:25, 51) is still read now that workspaces are primary; if only load_or_create reads the legacy file, remove the startup read.
findings.risk: Curation looks lost, with no explanation.
findings.verifier_note: Verified.

findings.title: Near-identical set_* field mutators repeat the get_mut / is_empty / remove dance
findings.evidence: Confirmed: set_scene_icon (318-343) and set_scene_accent (449-475) are isomorphic, as the doc comment at 444-447 admits. set_scene_tags and set_scene_favorite (398-437) use entry().or_default() followed by a remove-if-empty step.
findings.recommendation: As proposed: update_scene_entry(scene, |e| -> bool). The helper must compare before inserting, so that clearing a value on a missing entry creates nothing, as set_scene_accent's comment at 460-461 requires.
findings.risk: A new SceneEntry field needs several edits.
findings.verifier_note: Verified.

findings.title: Persistence ordering invariant lives in ui/background_io.rs; WorkspaceKey is three bare Strings
findings.evidence: Confirmed: the doc comment at 1, the WorkspaceKey Strings at 11-15, emptiness checked only in validate (138-140), and SerialLane in ui/background_io.rs.
findings.recommendation: Do not move SerialLane into storage. background_io hands completion callbacks back to GTK (glib), and storage must stay GTK-free. Take the second option instead: typed store handles in ui/background_io.rs (ConfigStore, WorkspaceStore) that capture their lane. Add WorkspaceKey newtypes after storage-infra-09.
findings.risk: Off-lane writes in the future.
findings.verifier_note: Dropped the option that moves the lane into storage, because it would pull GTK concerns into storage.

findings.title: The 'validate original, serialise, size-check, atomic write' sequence is duplicated in five stores
findings.evidence: Confirmed at the corrected lines. The bookmarks size check is hand-rolled at 72-77. FILE_LIMIT is defined twice: bookmarks.rs:7 (16 MiB) and report_history.rs:16 (64 MiB).
findings.recommendation: As proposed: a JsonDocument trait in src/storage/json_store.rs. report_history needs a compare-and-swap hook (expected snapshot), and the workspace store refuses-corrupt via read_store plus validate, so the trait needs a 'before replace' hook. Keep it to read_doc and replace_doc, and do not build a generic repository.
findings.risk: Fixes have to be applied five times.
findings.verifier_note: Line refs for bookmarks and report_history corrected; substance confirmed.

proposed_splits.rationale: Confirmed: about 692 production lines and 863 test lines (tests start at 693), mixing the DTO, mutators, colour helpers, policy mapping, the JSON adapter, the YAML adapter and the cfg(test) API.

target_modules.path: src/storage/registry.rs (keep as the module root; the crate uses registry.rs plus a registry/ dir, 2018 style)
